text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid single-day gains around 4–4.5%, with altcoins like Solana and BNB outpacing them slightly, suggesting appetite is broadening beyond the majors. The Fear & Greed index is in greed territory at 65 but has pulled back 6 points over the week, indicating sentiment remains constructive yet tempered. BTC dominance holding near 60% combined with $91B in daily volume reflects a healthy, balanced market without excessive concentration in any single asset.
